svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw 56 long from 45 x 30 flat bar; file or mill to 54 x 44 x 30.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the bar hole across the 44 width at mid-length, 15 up from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bottom: pilot, then 22 mm, then ream 22.2 (or bore it).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 8.5 holes straight through, 18 each side of the bar hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 13 each side of the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw the block in half along the bar hole's center line; file the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two sawn faces flat so the halves clamp the bar with a 1 mm gap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break every edge, especially round the bar hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lower half sits on the head plate over one of the two hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sets; the cap goes on over the bar; four M8 x 40 bolts (13 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: heads) go through both halves into the tapped plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bar turns in the closed clamp only with a firm twist.
